newsitem.title: UK: Taylor Woodrow buys London site by Thames.
newsitem.headline: Taylor Woodrow buys London site by Thames.

text.p: British builder Taylor Woodrow Plc said on Monday it had bought a riverside site in London from property group British Land Co Plc for 19 million stg.
Taylor Woodrow plans a residential development at the site in Battersea, south London, consisting of 101 units and incorporating a 20-storey tower.
Prices at the development, designed by architect Richard Rogers, would start at about 200,000 stg and rise to 3.5 million stg for the tower penthouse, the company said.
Construction was due to begin in mid-1997, with the first units available in 1998.
